## Specification

### Component: TimePicker

A segmented time field that behaves like a native `<input type="time">` (hour, minute, optional seconds, AM/PM), with an optional popover list of times at a fixed step. The value is a 24-hour string `"HH:mm"` (`"HH:mm:ss"` with seconds), or `null` while any segment is empty.

#### Anatomy
```
<TimePicker>                      <div class="ui-picker-field ui-timepicker" role="group">
  <svg.ui-picker-icon>            clock; shown only when there is no list
  .ui-timepicker-segments
    <input.ui-timepicker-segment role="spinbutton" data-segment="hour">      "09"
    <span.ui-timepicker-sep>:</span>
    <input … data-segment="minute">
    <input … data-segment="second">                                        only with `seconds`
    <input … data-segment="period">                                        AM / PM, only on a 12-hour clock
  <button.ui-input-action>        clear (x), while anything is filled in
  <button.ui-input-action>        clock, opens the list; only with `step`
  <input type="hidden">           name → "HH:mm"
  <PickerPanel.ui-timepicker-panel>   popover="manual", role="dialog"
    <div.ui-timepicker-list role="listbox"> <div.ui-timepicker-option role="option" aria-selected>
```

#### Props
- `value` / `defaultValue` (`string | null`), `onValueChange(string | null)`.
- `locale` (default `en-US`) decides 12 or 24 hours and the AM/PM words; `hour12` forces one; `seconds` adds a seconds segment.
- `step` (minutes): adds the popover list; `min` / `max` (`"HH:mm"`) limit the list and flag a value outside them as invalid. `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange`.
- `clearable` (default true), `disabled`, `required`, `name`, `id` (on the hour segment, which the `<Label>` targets), `size` (`sm` 32 · `md` 36 · `lg` 44), `labels` (`hour`, `minute`, `second`, `period`, `clear`, `open`, `list`).
- Inside a `<Field>` it picks up the id, `aria-describedby`, invalid, required and disabled state.

#### Behaviour
- Focus selects a segment. Arrow Up / Down step it with wrap-around (hours do not change AM/PM); an empty segment starts at its minimum going up and its maximum going down. Home / End jump to the minimum / maximum. Arrow Left / Right move between segments.
- Digits fill the segment and move on automatically: the first digit waits for a second only when one could follow (24-hour hour: 0–2 wait, 3–9 complete as 03–09; 12-hour hour: 0–1 wait; minutes and seconds: 0–5 wait). A second digit that would overshoot starts a new number ("2" then "5" in 24-hour gives 05). On a 12-hour clock "00" becomes 12.
- On the AM/PM segment, `a` and `p` (or the first letter of the locale's words) choose; Up / Down toggle.
- Backspace or Delete empties the segment; Backspace on an empty one moves to the previous. `:` `.` `,` `-` `/` and Space move to the next segment.
- The value is emitted as soon as every shown segment is filled, and as `null` when one is cleared afterwards. A value set from outside replaces the segments.
- Soft keyboards that send no key codes are handled from the input event (the last typed character counts).
- List (`step`): the clock button opens a listbox of times at that step, counting from midnight (15 → :00 :15 :30 :45). Focus moves to the selected time, or to the last step before the current value (marked `data-current`), scrolled to the middle of the list. Arrow keys / Home / End move, Enter / Space or a click picks, which fills the segments, closes the list and returns focus to the clock button. Alt + Arrow Down in a segment opens the list.
- Esc and an outside click close the list without a change; tabbing out closes it.

#### Visual rules
- The field matches Input and DatePicker (1px `--ui-border-strong`, `--radius-md`, tinted background in dark, hover and ring as Input); the ring shows while any segment has focus.
- Segments: `tabular-nums`, centred, `2ch + 8px` wide, height field − 12px, `--radius-sm`; empty ones show a muted "––". The focused segment fills with `--ui-accent`. Separators are muted.
- List panel: shared picker panel chrome, min width 136px, list max height 240px, 4px padding, options 32px tall (44px on touch), `--radius-md`; hover and current use `--ui-accent`; selected uses `--ui-primary` with `--ui-primary-foreground`.

#### Motion
- Panel enters with `ui-pop-in` and leaves with `ui-pop-out` like every popover; segment highlight changes in `--ui-duration-fast`. No scale on the list button (it opens a popup). Reduced motion: the panel only fades.

#### Accessibility
- The field is a `role="group"` (give it `aria-label`); each segment is a `role="spinbutton"` with `aria-label` ("Hour", "Minute", "Second", "AM or PM"), `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow` and `aria-valuetext` ("Empty" while blank).
- The list button has `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`; the list is a `listbox` of `option`s with `aria-selected`.
- Keyboard: see Behaviour; every action works without a pointer.

#### Acceptance checks
- Typing `0` `9` `3` `0` `p` in an en-US field gives "09:30 PM" and value `21:30`.
- Arrow Up on the hour of 12 AM shows 01; Arrow Down on minute 00 shows 59; the value updates each time.
- Backspace clears one segment and the value becomes `null`.
- With `step={15}` the list holds 96 times, opens on the current one scrolled into view, and picking one fills the field and closes the list.
- `locale="de-DE"` shows no AM/PM segment and hours 00–23.
- The hidden input holds `HH:mm`; a disabled picker submits nothing.
- 390px wide: nothing overflows; touch targets in the list are 44px.

### `ui/components/time-picker/time-list.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import type { KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import { useRovingFocus } from '../../hooks/use-roving-focus';
import { formatTimeLabel, nearestTimeIndex, timeToSeconds } from './time-utils';

export interface TimeListProps {
  /** "HH:mm" options, ascending. */
  options: string[];
  value: string | null;
  locale: string;
  hour12: boolean;
  seconds: boolean;
  label: string;
  onSelect: (value: string) => void;
}

/** CSS selector of the option that gets focus when the list opens. */
export const TIME_LIST_FOCUS = '.ui-timepicker-option[tabindex="0"]';

/** Scroll the list so the focused option sits in the middle (no page scroll). */
export function centerTimeOption(panel: HTMLElement) {
  const list = panel.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ui-timepicker-list');
  const option = list?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(TIME_LIST_FOCUS);
  if (!list || !option) return;
  list.scrollTop = Math.max(0, option.offsetTop - (list.clientHeight - option.offsetHeight) / 2);
}

/**
 * The popover list of times: a listbox with one option per step. The chosen
 * time is selected; when the value sits between steps, the last step before it
 * is marked as current. Arrow keys, Home and End move; Enter or Space picks.
 */
export function TimeList({ options, value, locale, hour12, seconds, label, onSelect }: TimeListProps) {
  const onKeyDown = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: '[role="option"]', orientation: 'vertical', loop: false, typeahead: false });
  const current = nearestTimeIndex(options, value);
  const target = timeToSeconds(value);

  return (
    <div role="listbox" aria-label={label} className="ui-timepicker-list" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
      {options.map((option, i) => {
        const selected = target !== null && timeToSeconds(option) === target;
        return (
          <div
            key={option}
            role="option"
            aria-selected={selected}
            tabIndex={i === current ? 0 : -1}
            className="ui-timepicker-option"
            data-current={(i === current && value !== null) || undefined}
            onClick={() => onSelect(option)}
            onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                onSelect(option);
              }
            }}
          >
            {formatTimeLabel(option, locale, hour12, seconds)}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/time-picker/time-picker.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  Fragment,
  forwardRef,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ChangeEvent,
  type CSSProperties,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
} from 'react';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { PickerPanel } from '../date-picker/picker-panel';
import { useFieldControl } from '../field/field-context';
import { TIME_LIST_FOCUS, TimeList, centerTimeOption } from './time-list';
import {
  clearSegment,
  emptySegments,
  segmentRange,
  segmentText,
  segmentsFromValue,
  segmentsToValue,
  setSegmentEdge,
  stepSegment,
  typeDigit,
  visibleSegments,
  type SegmentState,
  type TimeSegment,
} from './time-segments';
import { buildTimeOptions, compareTimes, getDayPeriodLabels, resolveHour12, type DayPeriod } from './time-utils';

export interface TimePickerLabels {
  hour?: string;
  minute?: string;
  second?: string;
  period?: string;
  clear?: string;
  /** The button that opens the list of times. */
  open?: string;
  /** The list of times. */
  list?: string;
}

export interface TimePickerProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange' | 'placeholder'> {
  /** "HH:mm" (24-hour), or "HH:mm:ss" with `seconds`. `null` means empty. */
  value?: string | null;
  defaultValue?: string | null;
  onValueChange?: (value: string | null) => void;
  /** BCP 47 tag; decides 12 or 24 hours and the AM/PM words. Default `en-US`. */
  locale?: string;
  /** Force a 12-hour (true) or 24-hour (false) clock. Default: the locale's. */
  hour12?: boolean;
  /** Show a seconds segment. */
  seconds?: boolean;
  /** Add a popover list of times every `step` minutes (15, 30, 60…). Without it there is no list. */
  step?: number;
  /** Earliest time in the list ("09:00"); a value before it is flagged invalid. */
  min?: string;
  /** Latest time in the list ("17:30"); a value after it is flagged invalid. */
  max?: string;
  open?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Show a clear button once something is filled in. Default true. */
  clearable?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  /** Submitted with a form as "HH:mm" through a hidden input. */
  name?: string;
  /** Id of the hour segment, which the <Label> targets. Inside a <Field> it follows the label. */
  id?: string;
  /** Height: 32 / 36 / 44px. Default `md`. */
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  labels?: TimePickerLabels;
}

type Buffer = { segment: TimeSegment; text: string } | null;

/**
 * TimePicker — segmented hour / minute (/ second) / AM-PM fields like a native
 * time input: arrows step, digits fill and move on, Backspace clears. Add `step`
 * for a popover list of times. The value is a "HH:mm" string, or null while
 * any segment is empty.
 */
export const TimePicker = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, TimePickerProps>(function TimePicker(props, forwardedRef) {
  const {
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue,
    onValueChange,
    locale = 'en-US',
    hour12: hour12Prop,
    seconds = false,
    step,
    min,
    max,
    open: openProp,
    defaultOpen = false,
    onOpenChange,
    clearable = true,
    disabled,
    required,
    name,
    id,
    size = 'md',
    labels,
    className,
    onClick,
    'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy,
    'aria-invalid': ariaInvalid,
    'aria-label': ariaLabel,
    'aria-labelledby': ariaLabelledBy,
    ...rest
  } = props;

  const L = {
    hour: 'Hour',
    minute: 'Minute',
    second: 'Second',
    period: 'AM or PM',
    clear: 'Clear time',
    open: 'Choose a time',
    list: 'Times',
    ...labels,
  };

  const listId = `${useId()}-list`;
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, rootRef);
  const listButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const segmentRefs = useRef<Partial<Record<TimeSegment, HTMLInputElement | null>>>({});

  const control = useFieldControl({ id, required, disabled, 'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy, 'aria-invalid': ariaInvalid });
  const isDisabled = !!control.disabled;

  const hour12 = resolveHour12(locale, hour12Prop);
  const periodLabels = useMemo(() => getDayPeriodLabels(locale), [locale]);
  const segments = visibleSegments(hour12, seconds);
  const hasList = !!step && step > 0;

  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState<string | null>({
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue: defaultValue ?? null,
    onChange: onValueChange,
  });
  const [openState, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const open = openState && hasList && !isDisabled;

  const [state, setState] = useState<SegmentState>(() => segmentsFromValue(value, hour12));
  const [buffer, setBuffer] = useState<Buffer>(null);

  // A value that arrives from outside replaces the segments, unless they already show it
  useEffect(() => {
    setState((prev) => (segmentsToValue(prev, hour12, seconds) === value ? prev : segmentsFromValue(value, hour12)));
  }, [value, hour12, seconds]);

  const update = (next: SegmentState) => {
    setState(next);
    setValue(segmentsToValue(next, hour12, seconds));
  };

  const focusSegment = (segment: TimeSegment | undefined) => {
    if (!segment) return;
    const el = segmentRefs.current[segment];
    el?.focus();
    el?.select();
  };
  const move = (from: TimeSegment, delta: 1 | -1) => focusSegment(segments[segments.indexOf(from) + delta]);

  const typeInto = (segment: 'hour' | 'minute' | 'second', digit: number) => {
    const pending = buffer && buffer.segment === segment ? buffer.text : '';
    const result = typeDigit(state, segment, digit, pending, hour12);
    setBuffer(result.buffer ? { segment, text: result.buffer } : null);
    update(result.state);
    if (result.advance) move(segment, 1);
  };

  const typePeriod = (char: string) => {
    const lower = char.toLowerCase();
    const first = (p: DayPeriod) => periodLabels[p].trim().charAt(0).toLowerCase();
    const picked: DayPeriod | null = lower === first('AM') || lower === 'a' ? 'AM' : lower === first('PM') || lower === 'p' ? 'PM' : null;
    if (picked) update({ ...state, period: picked });
  };

  const onSegmentKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>, segment: TimeSegment) => {
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    const key = e.key;
    const numeric = segment !== 'period';

    if (key === 'ArrowDown' && e.altKey && hasList) {
      e.preventDefault();
      setOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    if (e.altKey) return;

    switch (key) {
      case 'ArrowUp':
      case 'ArrowDown':
        e.preventDefault();
        setBuffer(null);
        update(stepSegment(state, segment, key === 'ArrowUp' ? 1 : -1, hour12));
        return;
      case 'Home':
      case 'End':
        e.preventDefault();
        setBuffer(null);
        update(setSegmentEdge(state, segment, key === 'Home' ? 'min' : 'max', hour12));
        return;
      case 'ArrowLeft':
        e.preventDefault();
        move(segment, -1);
        return;
      case 'ArrowRight':
        e.preventDefault();
        move(segment, 1);
        return;
      case 'Backspace':
      case 'Delete': {
        e.preventDefault();
        const empty = state[segment] === null;
        setBuffer(null);
        if (empty && key === 'Backspace') move(segment, -1);
        else update(clearSegment(state, segment));
        return;
      }
      case ':':
      case ' ':
      case ',':
      case '.':
      case '-':
      case '/':
        e.preventDefault();
        setBuffer(null);
        move(segment, 1);
        return;
    }

    if (key.length !== 1) return; // Tab, Enter, Escape, IME keys and the like keep their native behaviour
    e.preventDefault();
    if (numeric && /^\d$/.test(key)) typeInto(segment, Number(key));
    else if (!numeric) typePeriod(key);
  };

  // Soft keyboards often send no usable key: read the character from the input event instead
  const onSegmentChange = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>, segment: TimeSegment) => {
    const char = e.target.value.slice(-1);
    if (segment === 'period') typePeriod(char);
    else if (/^\d$/.test(char)) typeInto(segment, Number(char));
  };

  const invalidRange =
    value !== null && ((!!min && compareTimes(value, min) < 0) || (!!max && compareTimes(value, max) > 0));
  const invalid = invalidRange || (!!control['aria-invalid'] && control['aria-invalid'] !== 'false');
  const filled = state.hour !== null || state.minute !== null || state.second !== null || state.period !== null;

  const options = useMemo(
    () => (hasList ? buildTimeOptions({ step, min, max, seconds }) : []),
    [hasList, step, min, max, seconds],
  );

  const pickFromList = (next: string) => {
    setValue(next);
    setState(segmentsFromValue(next, hour12));
    setBuffer(null);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const onRootClick = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    onClick?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented || isDisabled) return;
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button, input, [role="dialog"]')) return;
    focusSegment(segments.find((s) => state[s] === null) ?? segments[0]);
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      role="group"
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      aria-labelledby={ariaLabelledBy}
      className={cn('ui-picker-field ui-timepicker', size !== 'md' && `ui-picker-field-${size}`, className)}
      data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      data-disabled={isDisabled || undefined}
      data-invalid={invalid || undefined}
      onClick={onRootClick}
      {...rest}
    >
      {!hasList && <Icon name="clock" className="ui-picker-icon ui-timepicker-icon" />}
      <div className="ui-timepicker-segments">
        {segments.map((segment, i) => {
          const isPeriod = segment === 'period';
          const range = isPeriod ? null : segmentRange(segment, hour12);
          const current = isPeriod ? null : state[segment];
          const text = isPeriod ? (state.period ? periodLabels[state.period] : '') : segmentText(state, segment, buffer?.segment === segment ? buffer.text : '');
          const label = L[segment];
          return (
            <Fragment key={segment}>
              {i > 0 && (
                <span className="ui-timepicker-sep" aria-hidden="true">
                  {isPeriod ? '' : ':'}
                </span>
              )}
              <input
                ref={(el) => {
                  segmentRefs.current[segment] = el;
                }}
                type="text"
                role="spinbutton"
                id={i === 0 ? control.id : undefined}
                className="ui-timepicker-segment"
                data-segment={segment}
                inputMode={isPeriod ? 'text' : 'numeric'}
                autoComplete="off"
                autoCapitalize="off"
                spellCheck={false}
                enterKeyHint="next"
                value={text}
                placeholder="––"
                disabled={isDisabled}
                style={isPeriod ? ({ '--ui-seg-ch': Math.max(2, periodLabels.AM.length, periodLabels.PM.length) } as CSSProperties) : undefined}
                aria-label={label}
                aria-valuemin={range?.[0]}
                aria-valuemax={range?.[1]}
                aria-valuenow={current ?? undefined}
                aria-valuetext={text || 'Empty'}
                aria-required={control.required || undefined}
                aria-invalid={invalid || undefined}
                aria-describedby={control['aria-describedby']}
                onKeyDown={(e) => onSegmentKeyDown(e, segment)}
                onChange={(e) => onSegmentChange(e, segment)}
                onFocus={(e) => e.currentTarget.select()}
                onMouseUp={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                onBlur={() => setBuffer((b) => (b && b.segment === segment ? null : b))}
              />
            </Fragment>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {clearable && !isDisabled && filled && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="ui-input-action"
          aria-label={L.clear}
          onClick={() => {
            setBuffer(null);
            update(emptySegments());
            focusSegment(segments[0]);
          }}
        >
          <Icon name="x" />
        </button>
      )}
      {hasList && (
        <button
          ref={listButtonRef}
          type="button"
          className="ui-input-action"
          aria-label={L.open}
          aria-haspopup="dialog"
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls={open ? listId : undefined}
          disabled={isDisabled}
          data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
          onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
        >
          <Icon name="clock" />
        </button>
      )}

      {name && <input type="hidden" name={name} value={value ?? ''} disabled={isDisabled} />}

      {hasList && (
        <PickerPanel
          open={open}
          onOpenChange={setOpen}
          anchorRef={rootRef}
          returnFocusRef={listButtonRef}
          id={listId}
          aria-label={L.open}
          className="ui-timepicker-panel"
          focusSelector={TIME_LIST_FOCUS}
          onOpened={centerTimeOption}
        >
          <TimeList
            options={options}
            value={value}
            locale={locale}
            hour12={hour12}
            seconds={seconds}
            label={L.list}
            onSelect={pickFromList}
          />
        </PickerPanel>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/time-picker/time-segments.ts`

```ts
import {
  formatTimeValue,
  fromTwelveHour,
  parseTimeValue,
  toTwelveHour,
  type DayPeriod,
} from './time-utils';

/** The editable parts of the field, left to right. */
export type TimeSegment = 'hour' | 'minute' | 'second' | 'period';

/**
 * What the field shows. `hour` is 1–12 on a 12-hour clock and 0–23 otherwise;
 * a part is null until it has been filled in.
 */
export interface SegmentState {
  hour: number | null;
  minute: number | null;
  second: number | null;
  period: DayPeriod | null;
}

export const emptySegments = (): SegmentState => ({ hour: null, minute: null, second: null, period: null });

/** Segments for a value string; empty for null or an invalid value. */
export function segmentsFromValue(value: string | null | undefined, hour12: boolean): SegmentState {
  const p = parseTimeValue(value);
  if (!p) return emptySegments();
  if (!hour12) return { hour: p.hour, minute: p.minute, second: p.second, period: null };
  const t = toTwelveHour(p.hour);
  return { hour: t.hour, minute: p.minute, second: p.second, period: t.period };
}

/** The value string, or null while any shown segment is still empty. */
export function segmentsToValue(state: SegmentState, hour12: boolean, seconds: boolean): string | null {
  const { hour, minute, second, period } = state;
  if (hour === null || minute === null) return null;
  if (seconds && second === null) return null;
  if (hour12 && period === null) return null;
  return formatTimeValue(
    { hour: hour12 ? fromTwelveHour(hour, period as DayPeriod) : hour, minute, second: seconds ? (second ?? 0) : 0 },
    seconds,
  );
}

/** The segments shown for a given configuration, in order. */
export function visibleSegments(hour12: boolean, seconds: boolean): TimeSegment[] {
  return ['hour', 'minute', ...(seconds ? (['second'] as const) : []), ...(hour12 ? (['period'] as const) : [])];
}

/** Lowest and highest number a numeric segment can hold. */
export function segmentRange(segment: 'hour' | 'minute' | 'second', hour12: boolean): [number, number] {
  if (segment === 'hour') return hour12 ? [1, 12] : [0, 23];
  return [0, 59];
}

/**
 * Arrow up/down: step a segment by `delta`, wrapping at the ends (hours do not
 * touch AM/PM). An empty segment starts from the low end going up, the high end going down.
 */
export function stepSegment(state: SegmentState, segment: TimeSegment, delta: 1 | -1, hour12: boolean): SegmentState {
  if (segment === 'period') {
    const next: DayPeriod = state.period === null ? (delta > 0 ? 'AM' : 'PM') : state.period === 'AM' ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    return { ...state, period: next };
  }
  const [lo, hi] = segmentRange(segment, hour12);
  const current = state[segment];
  const size = hi - lo + 1;
  const next = current === null ? (delta > 0 ? lo : hi) : ((current - lo + delta + size) % size) + lo;
  return { ...state, [segment]: next };
}

/** Home / End: jump a numeric segment to its lowest or highest value. */
export function setSegmentEdge(state: SegmentState, segment: TimeSegment, edge: 'min' | 'max', hour12: boolean): SegmentState {
  if (segment === 'period') return { ...state, period: edge === 'min' ? 'AM' : 'PM' };
  const [lo, hi] = segmentRange(segment, hour12);
  return { ...state, [segment]: edge === 'min' ? lo : hi };
}

/** Backspace / Delete: empty one segment. */
export function clearSegment(state: SegmentState, segment: TimeSegment): SegmentState {
  return { ...state, [segment]: null };
}

export interface TypeResult {
  state: SegmentState;
  /** Digits typed into this segment so far, waiting for a second one ('' when finished). */
  buffer: string;
  /** Move on to the next segment. */
  advance: boolean;
}

/**
 * A digit typed into a numeric segment. The first digit waits for a second
 * ("1" then "5" → 15) unless no second digit could follow ("7" → 07 and move on).
 * A second digit that would overshoot the range starts over ("2" then "5" in
 * 24-hour → 5). On a 12-hour clock "00" means 12.
 */
export function typeDigit(
  state: SegmentState,
  segment: 'hour' | 'minute' | 'second',
  digit: number,
  buffer: string,
  hour12: boolean,
): TypeResult {
  const [lo, hi] = segmentRange(segment, hour12);
  const firstMax = Math.floor(hi / 10);
  const set = (n: number | null) => ({ ...state, [segment]: n });

  if (buffer !== '') {
    let n = Number(buffer) * 10 + digit;
    if (segment === 'hour' && hour12 && n === 0) n = 12;
    if (n >= lo && n <= hi) return { state: set(n), buffer: '', advance: true };
    // Overshoot: treat this digit as the first of a new number
    return typeDigit(state, segment, digit, '', hour12);
  }

  if (digit > firstMax) return { state: set(digit), buffer: '', advance: true };
  // "0" on a 12-hour clock is not a value yet; keep what was there until the next digit
  return { state: digit >= lo ? set(digit) : state, buffer: String(digit), advance: false };
}

/** The text a numeric segment shows: two digits, or "" when empty. */
export function segmentText(state: SegmentState, segment: 'hour' | 'minute' | 'second', buffer = ''): string {
  if (buffer) return buffer.padStart(2, '0');
  const v = state[segment];
  return v === null ? '' : String(v).padStart(2, '0');
}
```

### `ui/components/time-picker/time-utils.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Time helpers for TimePicker. A time of day is a string `"HH:mm"` (or
 * `"HH:mm:ss"` with seconds), 24-hour, zero-padded — the format of
 * `<input type="time">` and of a form field.
 */

export interface TimeParts {
  /** 0–23 */
  hour: number;
  /** 0–59 */
  minute: number;
  /** 0–59 */
  second: number;
}

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');

/** Parse "HH:mm" or "HH:mm:ss" (also "H:mm"). Null for anything that is not a real time. */
export function parseTimeValue(value: string | null | undefined): TimeParts | null {
  const m = /^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?$/.exec((value ?? '').trim());
  if (!m) return null;
  const hour = Number(m[1]);
  const minute = Number(m[2]);
  const second = m[3] === undefined ? 0 : Number(m[3]);
  if (hour > 23 || minute > 59 || second > 59) return null;
  return { hour, minute, second };
}

/** "09:05" or, with seconds, "09:05:30". */
export function formatTimeValue(parts: TimeParts, seconds = false): string {
  const base = `${pad(parts.hour)}:${pad(parts.minute)}`;
  return seconds ? `${base}:${pad(parts.second)}` : base;
}

/** Seconds since midnight, for comparing and sorting. Null when `value` is not a time. */
export function timeToSeconds(value: string | null | undefined): number | null {
  const p = parseTimeValue(value);
  return p ? p.hour * 3600 + p.minute * 60 + p.second : null;
}

/** Negative when a is earlier than b. Unparseable values sort as equal. */
export function compareTimes(a: string, b: string): number {
  return (timeToSeconds(a) ?? 0) - (timeToSeconds(b) ?? 0);
}

/** Whether a locale writes a 12-hour clock ("3:30 PM") — or `override` when given. */
export function resolveHour12(locale: string | undefined, override?: boolean): boolean {
  if (override !== undefined) return override;
  const cycle = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { hour: 'numeric' }).resolvedOptions().hourCycle;
  return cycle === 'h11' || cycle === 'h12';
}

export type DayPeriod = 'AM' | 'PM';

/** 0 → 12 AM, 12 → 12 PM, 15 → 3 PM. */
export function toTwelveHour(hour24: number): { hour: number; period: DayPeriod } {
  return { hour: hour24 % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour24 % 12, period: hour24 >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM' };
}

/** 12 AM → 0, 12 PM → 12, 3 PM → 15. */
export function fromTwelveHour(hour: number, period: DayPeriod): number {
  return (hour % 12) + (period === 'PM' ? 12 : 0);
}

/** The locale's words for AM and PM ("AM" / "PM" in en-US, "a. m." in es). */
export function getDayPeriodLabels(locale: string | undefined): Record<DayPeriod, string> {
  const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { hour: 'numeric', hour12: true });
  const label = (h: number, fallback: string) =>
    fmt.formatToParts(new Date(2000, 0, 1, h)).find((p) => p.type === 'dayPeriod')?.value ?? fallback;
  return { AM: label(9, 'AM'), PM: label(15, 'PM') };
}

/** A time as the locale writes it: "3:30 PM" or "15:30". */
export function formatTimeLabel(value: string, locale: string | undefined, hour12: boolean, seconds = false): string {
  const p = parseTimeValue(value);
  if (!p) return value;
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: '2-digit',
    ...(seconds ? { second: '2-digit' as const } : null),
    hour12,
  }).format(new Date(2000, 0, 1, p.hour, p.minute, p.second));
}

/**
 * Every time from `min` to `max` (inclusive) in steps of `step` minutes.
 * `buildTimeOptions({ step: 15 })` → "00:00", "00:15", … "23:45".
 */
export function buildTimeOptions({
  step = 15,
  min = '00:00',
  max = '23:59',
  seconds = false,
}: {
  step?: number;
  min?: string;
  max?: string;
  seconds?: boolean;
} = {}): string[] {
  const size = Math.max(1, Math.floor(step));
  const from = Math.ceil((timeToSeconds(min) ?? 0) / 60);
  const to = Math.floor((timeToSeconds(max) ?? 86399) / 60);
  const out: string[] = [];
  // Steps count from midnight, so a 15-minute list stays on :00 :15 :30 :45 whatever `min` is
  for (let m = Math.ceil(from / size) * size; m <= to && m < 1440; m += size) {
    out.push(formatTimeValue({ hour: Math.floor(m / 60), minute: m % 60, second: 0 }, seconds));
  }
  return out;
}

/** Index of the last option at or before `value`, else 0. -1 for an empty list. */
export function nearestTimeIndex(options: string[], value: string | null | undefined): number {
  if (!options.length) return -1;
  const target = timeToSeconds(value);
  if (target === null) return 0;
  let found = 0;
  options.forEach((o, i) => {
    if ((timeToSeconds(o) ?? 0) <= target) found = i;
  });
  return found;
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-roving-focus.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';

export type Orientation = 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both';

const isDisabled = (el: HTMLElement) =>
  el.hasAttribute('disabled') || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || el.hasAttribute('data-disabled');

/**
 * Arrow-key focus movement across items inside a container, with Home/End
 * and typeahead. Spread the returned handler on the container:
 *   const onKeyDown = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: '[role="menuitem"]' });
 *   <div role="menu" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>…</div>
 */
export function useRovingFocus({
  itemSelector,
  orientation = 'vertical',
  loop = true,
  typeahead = true,
  onMove,
}: {
  itemSelector: string;
  orientation?: Orientation;
  loop?: boolean;
  typeahead?: boolean;
  onMove?: (item: HTMLElement) => void;
}) {
  const buffer = useRef('');
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  return useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      const items = Array.from(e.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(itemSelector)).filter(
        (el) => !isDisabled(el) && el.getClientRects().length > 0,
      );
      if (!items.length) return;
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      const index = items.findIndex((el) => el === active || (active !== null && el.contains(active)));
      const go = (item: HTMLElement | undefined) => {
        if (!item) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        item.focus();
        onMove?.(item);
      };
      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (index === -1) return items[delta > 0 ? 0 : items.length - 1];
        let next = index + delta;
        if (loop) next = (next + items.length) % items.length;
        else next = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, next));
        return items[next];
      };
      const v = orientation !== 'horizontal';
      const h = orientation !== 'vertical';
      switch (e.key) {
        case 'ArrowDown':
          if (v) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          if (v) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          if (h) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          if (h) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'Home':
          go(items[0]);
          return;
        case 'End':
          go(items[items.length - 1]);
          return;
      }
      if (!typeahead || e.key.length !== 1 || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).matches('input, textarea')) return;
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      buffer.current += e.key.toLowerCase();
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        buffer.current = '';
      }, 500);
      go(items.find((el) => (el.textContent ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(buffer.current)));
    },
    [itemSelector, orientation, loop, typeahead, onMove],
  );
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

```ts
/* Icon shapes for a 24x24, stroke-based grid.
   Shapes follow the Lucide icon set (ISC licence, https://lucide.dev). */

export const iconPaths = {
  x: '<path d="M18 6 6 18"/><path d="m6 6 12 12"/>',
  check: '<path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/>',
  plus: '<path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="M12 5v14"/>',
  minus: '<path d="M5 12h14"/>',
  'chevron-down': '<path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/>',
  'chevron-up': '<path d="m18 15-6-6-6 6"/>',
  'chevron-left': '<path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"/>',
  'chevron-right': '<path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"/>',
  'chevrons-up-down': '<path d="m7 15 5 5 5-5"/><path d="m7 9 5-5 5 5"/>',
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/time-picker.css`

```css
/* TimePicker --------------------------------------------------------------
   Built on the shared .ui-picker-field / .ui-picker-panel of date-picker.css.

   <div class="ui-picker-field ui-timepicker" role="group" data-state data-disabled data-invalid>
     <svg class="ui-picker-icon ui-timepicker-icon">            (only when there is no list)
     <div class="ui-timepicker-segments">
       <input class="ui-timepicker-segment" role="spinbutton" data-segment="hour|minute|second|period">
       <span class="ui-timepicker-sep">:</span> …
     </div>
     <button class="ui-input-action" aria-label="Clear time">  <button class="ui-input-action" aria-haspopup="dialog">
     <input type="hidden" name="start" value="09:30">
     <div class="ui-floating ui-picker-panel ui-timepicker-panel" popover="manual">
       <div class="ui-timepicker-list" role="listbox"> <div class="ui-timepicker-option" role="option" aria-selected [data-current]">
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-timepicker { cursor: text; padding-inline-start: var(--ui-input-px, 0.75rem); gap: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-timepicker[data-disabled] { cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-timepicker-icon { flex-shrink: 0; }

  /* The ring follows the segment you are in */
  .ui-timepicker:has(.ui-timepicker-segment:focus) {
    --ui-input-border: var(--ui-ring);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-timepicker[data-invalid]:has(.ui-timepicker-segment:focus) {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 25%, transparent);
  }

  .ui-timepicker-segments {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1 1 0%;
    align-items: center;
    min-width: 0;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .ui-timepicker-sep { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); user-select: none; }
  .ui-timepicker-sep:empty { width: 0.25rem; }

  .ui-timepicker-segment {
    --ui-seg-ch: 2;
    width: calc(var(--ui-seg-ch) * 1ch + 0.5rem);
    height: calc(var(--ui-input-h, 2.25rem) - 0.75rem);
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    text-align: center;
    /* Digits are typed through key handlers; no caret or selection colour to show */
    caret-color: transparent;
    outline: none;
    cursor: text;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-timepicker-segment::placeholder { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); opacity: 1; }
  .ui-timepicker-segment::selection { background: transparent; }
  .ui-timepicker-segment:focus {
    background-color: var(--ui-accent);
    color: var(--ui-accent-foreground);
  }
  .ui-timepicker-segment:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-timepicker-segment[data-segment="period"] { text-transform: uppercase; }

  /* ---- Time list -------------------------------------------------------- */
  .ui-timepicker-panel { min-width: 8.5rem; }
  .ui-timepicker-list {
    position: relative;
    max-height: 15rem;
    padding: 0.25rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
  }
  .ui-timepicker-option {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 2rem;
    padding-inline: 0.625rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-timepicker-option[data-current] { background-color: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-accent-foreground); }
  .ui-timepicker-option[aria-selected="true"] {
    background-color: var(--ui-primary);
    color: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .ui-timepicker-option:focus-visible { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 70%, transparent); }
  .ui-timepicker-option[aria-selected="true"]:focus-visible {
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--ui-primary-foreground);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-timepicker-option:hover:not([aria-selected="true"]) { background-color: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-accent-foreground); }
  }
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-timepicker-option { height: 2.75rem; }
    .ui-timepicker-segment { min-width: 2.25rem; }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Meeting time** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/time-picker/meeting-time.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Field, FieldHint, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { TimePicker } from '@/ui/components/time-picker';

export default function TimePickerMeetingTime() {
  const [time, setTime] = useState<string | null>('09:30');

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
      <Field>
        <Label>Meeting time</Label>
        <TimePicker value={time} onValueChange={setTime} step={15} min="08:00" max="18:00" name="meeting_time" />
        <FieldHint>
          {time ? `Stand-up starts at ${time} (24-hour value).` : 'Type a time or open the list. Slots run every 15 minutes.'}
        </FieldHint>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```
